Karina Ramírez Arras signed in suplencia del Subsecretario de Hacienda y Crédito Público.","outcome":"Formalized tax stimulus rates and quota amounts for gasoline <91 octanos (26.96% stimulus, $1.4803 MXN/litro, quota $4.0114 MXN/litro), gasoline ≥91 octanos and non-fossil fuels (0% stimulus, $0 MXN/litro, quota $4.6375 MXN/litro), and diésel (59.77% stimulus, $3.6071 MXN/litro, quota $2.4283 MXN/litro) for December 10–16, 2022.","dates":["2022-12-08 (publication date)","2022-12-10 to 2022-12-16 (applicable period)"],"quantities":["26.96% stimulus rate for gasoline <91 octanos","$1.4803 MXN/litro monetary stimulus for gasoline <91 octanos","$4.0114 MXN/litro IEPS quota for gasoline <91 octanos","59.77% stimulus rate for diesel","$3.6071 MXN/litro monetary stimulus for diesel","$2.4283 MXN/litro IEPS quota for diesel","0.00% stimulus rate for gasoline ≥91 octanos and non-fossil fuels","$4.6375 MXN/litro IEPS quota for gasoline ≥91 octanos and non-fossil fuels"],"excerpt":"ACUERDO por el que se dan a conocer los porcentajes, los montos del estímulo fiscal y las cuotas disminuidas del impuesto especial sobre producción y servicios, así como las cantidades por litro aplicables a los combustibles que se indican, correspondientes al periodo comprendido del 10 al 16 de diciembre de 2022","locator":"extracted HTML block 1","attribution":"Secretaría de Hacienda y Crédito Público, Gobierno de México; Karina Ramírez Arras, Titular de la Unidad de Política de Ingresos no Tributarios; published in the Diario Oficial de la Federación.","period_fit":"Weak. The document covers a single weekly period (December 10–16, 2022) and does not describe the broader economic trajectory, implementation quality, or outcomes of the stimulus policy beyond the stated rates. monetary stimulus amounts in pesos per litre derived from the same differentiation.","outcome":"Differentiated tax burden across fuel types, with diesel receiving the largest fiscal stimulus per litre ($3.6071 MXN), lower-octane gasoline receiving a moderate stimulus ($1.4803 MXN), and higher-octane gasoline receiving none.","dates":["2022-12-10 to 2022-12-16 (applicable period)"],"quantities":["26.96% stimulus for gasoline <91 octanos ($1.4803 MXN/litro)","0.00% stimulus for gasoline ≥91 octanos ($0.0000 MXN/litro)","59.77% stimulus for diesel ($3.6071 MXN/litro)","Diesel quota ($2.4283 MXN/litro) below lower-octane gasoline quota ($4.0114 MXN/litro)","Higher-octane gasoline quota ($4.6375 MXN/litro) highest among all categories"],"excerpt":"Gasolina menor a 91 octanos 26.96%, $1.4803, $4.0114 / Gasolina mayor o igual a 91 octanos y combustibles no fósiles 0.00%, $0.0000, $4.6375 / Diésel 59.77%, $3.6071, $2.4283","locator":"extracted HTML block 2","attribution":"Secretaría de Hacienda y Crédito Público, Gobierno de México;
